# CONF-001: server/discover exists and lists supported versions and capabilities

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/versioning#protocol-version-negotiation](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/versioning#protocol-version-negotiation) |

Sends server/discover with valid request metadata. Servers MUST implement it; the result must carry supportedVersions (a non-empty list of strings) and a capabilities object. Server identity is a SHOULD and is checked separately by CONF-017.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-001`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-001"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
